coords: tile units. mesa(x, y, w) style. multiply by 40 for pixels.
applyTo: src/game/levelGen.ts buildSignatureOp1 slots 0-8, and Operation 1 slot 9 boss arena

rules.l1Finish: floor drop into the next level
rules.l2Open: spawn in the sealed cave the L1 shaft dropped into
rules.l3: sky run first, shot bridge over the gorge is the middle, not the start
rules.l3Tell: neon SHOOT plate on the lip plus a hinge target on the drawbridge
rules.l4: rim run first, needle drop is the middle, belts carry you up
rules.l5: storm run first, eight belts 110 to 180 by tens, seed wall, tube up
rules.l6: narrow tube, 60-tile required climb, cage at top, door after flock, no van part
rules.l7: 22-tile dump, 32-tile wall, 28-tile shock descent, two optional SHOOT cages
rules.l8: approach first, eight springs over eight shocks, wall at the end
rules.l9: extra long plateau, seed early, Don arrives at the far end and does not fight
rules.l10: Don Corvone boss arena, three phases, extract, Honey Bun is in another canyon

levels.name: Desert Briefing
levels.blurb: Honey Bun is already gone, and the crumbs spell a path across the dunes until the ground gives way.
levels.note: Finish is the drop, not a door after the gag. Three checkpoints. Side spikes punish a miss. The shaft is the clear.

acts.label: Approach
acts.note: Crumb dunes. First gaps are hops. Checkpoint 1.

acts.label: Flock
acts.note: The canyon. Fall-through deck, four birds, checkpoint 2.

acts.label: Drop
acts.note: Checkpoint 3 on the lip. The floor gives way. The fall is Level 2.

levels.name: Neon Caves
levels.blurb: The fall ends in a sealed cave, and the jump pad at the end is the only way back to the sky.
levels.note: Opens in the cave Level 1 dropped you into. Spring reach is about 13 tiles, so the sky lip sits 11 above the pad. Three checkpoints.

acts.label: Landing
acts.note: You fell in. The shaft is capped. Checkpoint 1.

acts.label: Descent
acts.note: The sealed cave. You go down. Checkpoint 2.

acts.label: Spring
acts.note: Checkpoint 3 on the pad lip. The spring is the only way to the sky.

levels.name: Sky Bridges
levels.blurb: The rails look like a clean signal, but the bridge you shoot will break and slide you into the spikes.
levels.note: Longer sky run. The tell is a neon SHOOT plate on the lip and a hinge target on the near end of the drawbridge. Shoot the hinge. Three checkpoints.

acts.label: Sky run
acts.note: Longer pylon run. Checkpoint 1, then the warning lip.

acts.label: Break
acts.note: SHOOT plate on the lip. Hinge on the drawbridge. It slides into the spikes.

acts.label: Exit
acts.note: Checkpoint 3, flock, goal on its own mesa.

levels.name: Spike Gorge
levels.blurb: The broken bridge drops you onto the needles, and a conveyor belt is already waiting to carry you up.
levels.note: Opens on the rim after the sky run. The drop is the middle. Four belts carry you up. Three checkpoints.

acts.label: Rim
acts.note: A run along the gorge. Checkpoints 1 and 2. The floor has not given way.

acts.label: Drop
acts.note: Crumble onto the needles. The belts are already waiting.

acts.label: Climb
acts.note: Checkpoint 3 at the top of the belts. Exit ridge, then the door.

levels.name: Belt Run
levels.blurb: The belts shove you forward through the storm, and the exit is a wall of giant broken seeds.
levels.note: Storm run first. Shove is eight belts, 110 to 180 by tens, into the giant broken seeds. The tube is still the way up. Three checkpoints.

acts.label: Storm
acts.note: A run before the belts own you. Checkpoints 1 and 2.

acts.label: Shove
acts.note: Eight belts. 110 to 180 by tens. Then the seed wall.

acts.label: Tube
acts.note: The ladder up. Checkpoint 3. Goal on the far ridge.

levels.name: Vertical Ascent
levels.blurb: The tube climbs to a giant bird cage, and the door opens only after the flock is gone.
levels.note: Narrow tube, 60 tiles of required climb. Decks every 4 tiles, more than a jump. Cage is visible at the top. Door after the flock. Operation 1 has no van part. Three checkpoints.

acts.label: Lower tube
acts.note: Spawn on the floor. Four-tile rises. Checkpoint 1.

acts.label: Mid tube
acts.note: The climb continues. Checkpoint 2. No spring, no skip.

acts.label: Cage
acts.note: Checkpoint 3 under the cage. Eight birds. Door opens after the flock. No van part.

levels.name: Vertical Descent
levels.blurb: The cage door dumps you onto a long wall, and two optional cages are worth shooting on the way to the lines.
levels.note: Dump is 22 tiles. Wall is 32. Lines are a 28-tile descent through four shock rows. Three checkpoints.

acts.label: Dump
acts.note: Cage door. 22-tile fall onto the wall. Checkpoint 1.

acts.label: Wall
acts.note: Long descent. Two optional cages, both marked SHOOT.

acts.label: Lines
acts.note: Four rows of shock lines. Spring is the bail at the bottom.

levels.name: Hardpan
levels.blurb: The power lines bounce under your feet, and a missed jump will shock you before the wall at the end.
levels.note: Approach first. Bounce field is eight springs over eight shocks. The wall is the end, not the start. Three checkpoints.

acts.label: Approach
acts.note: A run before the lines. Checkpoints 1 and 2.

acts.label: Bounce
acts.note: Eight springs. A shock under each. Miss and you eat the line.

acts.label: Wall
acts.note: Checkpoint 3, then the wall, then the door.

levels.name: Mafia Approach
levels.blurb: The plateau does not show an end, the seed is early, and the portal is Don Corvone arriving.
levels.note: Extra long plateau. 520 tiles, past the minute. Seed is early. Don arrives at the far end and does not fight here. Three checkpoints.

acts.label: Early
acts.note: Seed and chaos are here. Checkpoint 1. The end is not in frame.

acts.label: Plateau
acts.note: One long mesa. Birds. Checkpoint 2. Still no end.

acts.label: Don
acts.note: Checkpoint 3, then Don Corvone arrives. He does not fight. He opens Level 10.

levels.name: Don Corvone
levels.blurb: Kingpin has Honey Bun AI — three phases. Extract him.
levels.note: Boss arena, not a runway. Three phases, three checkpoints. After the extract: Sorry, your Honey Bun is in another canyon. The 10th Neon Chaos Seed can spawn here if all 9 were taken.

acts.label: Phase 1
acts.note: The floor. Springs on the sides. Don is on the perch. Checkpoint 1.

acts.label: Phase 2
acts.note: He goes up. Tiers and moving decks. Checkpoint 2.

acts.label: Phase 3
acts.note: Pillars close. Checkpoint 3. Extract him. He does not fight on the plateau.
